defense_news.title: The devastation of NSA Bahrain is a national security warning
defense_news.summary: If NSA Bahrain is not reconstituted to pre-attack capabilities, it will fundamentally change how the U.S. Navy operates, the author of this op-ed writes.

defense_news.title: Air Force awards Boeing $131 billion ceiling contract for F-15 production, modernization
defense_news.summary: The Air Force has awarded Boeing a sole-source contract with a $131.23 billion ceiling to produce, modernize and sustain F-15 fighters.

defense_news.title: India turns to private sector to ramp up missile production
defense_news.summary: Fearing bottlenecks, India has approved the transfer of technologies for conventional missile systems from a state-run organization to private companies.

defense_news.title: Russia is running out of cash due to its war in Ukraine: report
defense_news.summary: Russia’s war spending pushed the state to the brink of running out of cash this spring, according to a Bloomberg report, as Russian leaders double down.
